instruction.name: vsll.w
instruction.description: Logical left shift each unsigned 32-bit element in `a` by the corresponding element of `b` modulo 32, store the result in `dst`.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form a vector-register dependency chain. Measured with unroll=100000 to amortise call overhead.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vsll.w $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vsll.w $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vsll.w $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vsll.w $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vsll.w $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vsll.w $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vsll.w $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vsll.w $vr7, $vr15, $vr23
